description: This file defines a utility class `ConnectivityHeaders` that provides static methods to determine whether certain headers related to connectivity should be logged or not. It includes methods for checking debug log levels based on header values, with internal handling of allowed values via an enum.

classes.name: ConnectivityHeaders
classes.description: A final utility class for inspecting connectivity-related headers in messaging contexts.

methods.name: isHeadersDebugLogEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the headers permit debug logging based on header value.

methods.name: isPayloadDebugLogEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the payload associated with the headers can be logged for debugging.

methods.name: getDebugLogValue
methods.description: Retrieves the debug log value from headers, defaulting to 'ALL' if the header is absent.
